More articles Frequently Asked Questions Expand all Collapse all Is Wave's software something I need to install? Wave's tools are web-based, so you just need an Internet connection and browser—no installation is necessary for our online software! ‍ If you're looking for an on-the-go solution, you can install our mobile app to help you manage invoices and payments. Download our mobile app on iOS and Android today! Is my data secure when I use Wave? Our servers are protected physically and electronically. Any connections between you, your bank accounts, and Wave are protected by 256-bit SSL encryption. Wave is a PCI-DSS Level 1 Service Provider. Do you provide customer support? We provide different levels of support, depending on the plan and/or the add-on features you choose. Learn more about how Wave support works here . How do I know what to charge when invoicing my freelance clients? The rate that you charge for your freelancing services can vary, so it's important to get a grasp of market trends before sending your clients an invoice or quoting a price. Freelance rates can differ depending on experience level and industry. For example, the rate a freelance web developer charges may be different than that of a freelance graphic designer , because each freelancer specializes in a different area. Is invoicing software helpful for freelancers? Absolutely! Whether you're a freelance writer , a freelance editor , a freelance front-end developer , or even a freelance balloon maker (no articles on that yet, sorry), you can use invoicing software to send professional looking invoices to your clients and get paid faster. What are the benefits of digital invoicing? Manually creating invoices in Microsoft Word or Excel can be time-consuming and difficult to manage. Digital invoicing empowers your small business by automating invoice processing and saving time by tracking key invoice data like upcoming and outstanding invoices. You can also manage late payments more efficiently through e-invoicing by setting up payment reminders to send to your customers before an invoice due date. How is a digital invoice different from a paper-based invoice? Electronic invoices are created with online invoicing software or other cloud-based services, which makes it easy to automate the invoicing process. Electronic invoices also provide small business owners with professional-looking digital invoices that their customers can pay easily online through a system like Wave’s online payments . ‍ On the other hand, paper-based invoicing is a manual process requiring extra time for things like invoice tracking and following up on overdue invoices, which can keep you away from the best parts of running your small business. How do I calculate taxes on my invoices? A common issue when invoicing in Microsoft Word, Excel, or other DIY solutions is making calculation errors. Wave's invoicing software for small businesses removes the worry of making these errors because calculations are done for you, including the taxes. What payment methods can my customers use? Your customers can pay the invoices you send them instantly by credit card, secure bank payment (ACH/EFT), or Apple Pay. And by enabling Wave’s payments feature , you can accept credit cards and bank payments, and get paid out in as fast as 1-2 business days 1 . Does Wave offer recurring invoicing? We sure do! With a Wave Pro subscription, you'll have recurring billing and other automation features. Schedule everything, from invoice creation and invoice sending, to payment collection and overdue payment reminders. Can I create and send invoices on the go? Most definitely! The Wave app lets you easily generate and send invoices to your clients wherever and whenever you need to. How can I send my customers an invoice? With Wave’s web-based invoicing software, you can create and send invoices for your business in just a few clicks from your computer. All you need is an Internet connection and a browser! If you’re on-the-go, you can also send invoices from your phone or other mobile device using the Wave app . How can I create an invoice? Sign up for Wave and send your first invoice right away—it only takes a few minutes! With the Pro Plan you can also set up recurring payments, auto-reminders, and deposit requests to make sure you always get paid on time. 1 Payouts are processed in 1-2 business days for credit card payments and 1-7 business days for bank payments. text: How to Manage Your Digital Listings – Etsy Help Skip to content Help Center Sign in Shopping on Etsy Selling with Etsy Etsy Help Selling with Etsy Listings Creating a Listing How to Manage Your Digital Listings Digital items come in two categories: Instant downloads : Ready-made files that the buyer can access immediately upon purchase Made-to-order downloads : Custom files made to a buyer’s specification that will be sent to them upon completion. Like handmade items, digital items listed in your store must be made and/or designed by you, the seller. Follow the instructions to list an item on Etsy and choose Digital files under the What type of item is it? prompt . To create a made-to-order digital listing: Go to the When did you make it? dropdown. Select Made To Order . How to add files to your digital listing When listing a digital item that is an instant download, you’ll need to upload the files that the buyer is purchasing when you create the listing. You can upload up to five digital files. The maximum size for each file is 20MB. Supported file types .bmp .doc .gif .jpeg .jpg .mobi .mov .mp3 .mpeg .pdf .png .psp .rtf .stl .txt .zip .ePUB .iBook Uploaded files will appear in a list with their names, file sizes, and upload dates. The file names you see will be the same ones your buyers see. We don't have a way of editing the name after uploading, so be sure to name your files appropriately first. File names are limited to 70 alphanumeric characters, periods, underscores, or hyphens. Add a note for buyers You can add a note for buyers that will apply to all digital listings purchased from your shop. After a purchase, a buyer can see the note on their Downloads page. Can I offer variations for my digital items? No, you can’t offer variations for digital items. How can I change the file attached to an instant digital listing? To remove a file, select the X icon next to its file name when you create or edit a listing, and add new files to the listing using the Add files button. You will be unable to publish or save an instant digital listing if there is no file attached to it. Canceling an order is the only way to revoke a buyer’s access to a file after it has been purchased. If I exclusively sell digital items, will I be eligible for Star Seller? Yes, if you sell only digital items, you’re still eligible for Star Seller . When you view your Star Seller dashboard you won’t see an on-time shipping & tracking score, but you’ll still be considered based on other metrics. How to complete made-to-order digital orders Unlike instant downloads, you don’t upload a file when creating a made-to-order digital listing. Once you’re ready to send the finished file to the buyer, complete the order through the following steps: On Etsy.com , go to your Shop Manager and select Orders . Your incomplete orders are displayed under the New tab. Check the box of the order you want to finish, then choose Complete order . Select the Upload file button. You can attach up to five files with a maximum size of 20MB each. Finish by selecting the Complete order button. The buyer will be notified by email that their order is now available for download. Price Kris Rivenburgh: $495 Technical Accessibility Experts: $195 Email us info@accessible.org Frequently Asked Questions How much does a website accessibility audit cost? Most website accessibility audits range between $1,250 and $2,750. Pricing is $100 to $250 per primary page or screen and $25 to $100 for light pages or screens. Because our audits are custom and fully manual, your final cost depends on scope, status, and complexity. How is the audit price determined? Three factors set the price: scope (the number and type of pages or screens in your representative sample), status (how accessible the asset already is), and complexity (interactive components, dynamic content, and custom widgets). We evaluate a representative sample rather than every page. What is the difference between a primary page and a light page? Primary pages are content rich or interactive pages and screens, priced at $100 to $250 each. Light pages have minimal content or repeated patterns and are priced lower, at $25 to $100 each. Light pages can be simple pages like a privacy policy page or simple How much does an ACR cost? Most clients choose our WCAG edition VPAT service, which is $350 in addition to the cost of the audit. We complete the Voluntary Product Accessibility Template (VPAT) and produce a finished Accessibility Conformance Report (ACR) based on the audit. Other editions are Section 508 at $550, EN 301 549 at $650, and the INT combined edition at $950. The different amounts represent the time necessary to fill out the different editions. What WCAG standards do you evaluate against? We evaluate digital assets against WCAG 2.1 AA or WCAG 2.2 AA, and occasionally WCAG 2.0 AA. Are your audits manual or automated? Fully manual. There is no such thing as an automated audit. Our technical accessibility experts will evaluate your asset using screen reader testing (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver, and/or TalkBack), keyboard testing, visual inspection, and code inspection. We use an automated scan only as a review, to confirm that every scan detectable issue is included in the final audit report. What do I receive at the end of an audit? A detailed technical audit report delivered as an Excel spreadsheet, with specific findings, the WCAG criteria affected, and the information your team needs to take action on each issue. Do you fix the issues you find? We can support remediation in two ways. Technical support, at $195 per hour with a two hour minimum, gives your team expert help and validates fixes (to ensure the fix has resolved the issue). Document remediation, starting at $7.00 per page, covers PDFs, Word documents, PowerPoint presentations, and Excel spreadsheets. How much does document remediation cost? Document remediation starts at $7.00 per page. PDFs start at $7.50 per page, while Word documents and PowerPoint presentations start at $7.00 per page. Final pricing depends on document status and project scope. Do you offer rush or expedited service? Yes. Expedited accessibility, including same day or overnight turnaround, ranges from $250 to $750 depending on scope and timing. Is certification an extra cost? No. Certification is included at no additional cost as a result of our services. To qualify for a statement of conformance or certification, your asset must be fully WCAG conformant. A statement of partial conformance is available when the only remaining issues are outside your control. Can you audit mobile apps and other digital assets? Yes. We audit websites, web apps, mobile apps, software, platforms, dashboards, portals, multimedia players, and individual components. Audits can be conducted in desktop and/or mobile environments. Do you offer user testing with people with disabilities? Yes. User testing is conducted by an accessibility professional with a disability using assistive technology, and the session is recorded for your team. Sessions are $550, or $450 when combined with audit services, and cover up to 10 pages or screens. How do I get a quote or get started? Email info@accessible.org or use our contact page. You can also try our cost calculator for a fast estimate. Ready to Start? We’re ready to help you with accessibility as soon as possible. We provide upfront quotes, clear expectations, and fast turnarounds. Send us a message and we’ll reply very soon.
